columns.name: Property worth Rs. 11,855 lakh was recovered during 1990 showing an increase of 5 per cent over the previous year. In the decade under consideration, the recovery has recorded substantial increase of 233.1 per cent which is much more than the percentage increase in the value of property stolen (167.8%). Recovery percentage {(recovered/stolen)x100} has thus improved in the decade resulting in 24.1 per cent increase in 1990 over 1980.
